plain_language_summary: Cover that shrinks each year, designed to pay off a reducing loan (for example a home loan) if the borrower dies.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 5 to 30
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
death_benefit: Cover in policy year t (t = 1..n) = initial sum assured x (1 - v^(n-t+1)) / (1 - v^n), with v = 1/1.09: the outstanding balance, at the start of year t, of an n-year loan at 9% a year repaid in equal yearly instalments.
key_features: Match the initial sum assured to your outstanding loan and the term to the remaining loan tenure; cover falls like a 9% loan balance; pay once or over 5 years.
surrender_and_lock_in: Single pay: surrender value available (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 1 crore or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: A small, simple term plan for first-time buyers and lower incomes. Simplified underwriting, so the rate per Rs 1,000 is higher than Kesaro Term.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 5 to 30
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to Rs 25 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: 100% of sum assured, as a lump sum.
key_features: Cover from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 50 lakh; minimum income Rs 1 lakh a year; no medical tests up to Rs 25 lakh (simplified).
medical_underwriting: No medical tests up to Rs 25 lakh; tele-medical above that (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Term cover that refunds the base premiums you paid if you survive the policy term. Costs roughly 1.75 to 2.5 times a plain term plan (more for shorter terms).
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 20 to 40
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to the lower of 5 x the spouse's annual income and Rs 50 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: 100% of sum assured, as a lump sum.
maturity_benefit: 100% of the total base premiums actually paid (including any modal loading; excluding rider premiums), paid if the life assured survives the term.
key_features: Get your base premiums back on survival; policy terms 20 to 40 years; regular or 10-year pay; terminal-illness benefit built in.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value available after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 1 crore or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Protection whose cover grows each year to keep pace with rising living costs. Premium stays level.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 10 to 40
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
death_benefit: Current cover: initial sum assured increased by 5% of the initial sum assured for every completed policy year, up to a maximum of 200% of the initial sum assured.
key_features: Cover rises automatically by 5% of the starting cover every year (max 2x); level premium; terminal-illness benefit built in.
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 1 crore or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Pure protection. Pays the sum assured if the life assured dies during the policy term. Nothing is paid if they survive the term.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 10 to 40
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to the lower of 10 x the spouse's annual income and Rs 1 crore. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: 100% of sum assured, as a lump sum.
key_features: Cover from Rs 25 lakh up to Rs 25 crore; choose any policy term from 10 to 40 years (cover ends by age 85); pay every year, for 10 years only, or once; terminal-illness benefit built in; lower rates per Rs 1,000 for larger covers.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force. Death due to participation in criminal acts. Non-disclosure of material facts may lead to claim rejection within the first 3 policy years.
surrender_and_lock_in: No surrender value for regular pay. Limited/single pay: a small surrender value is payable (see policy document); not modelled in this pack.
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 1 crore or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Guaranteed lifelong cover to age 99, often used for leaving a legacy. No bonuses.
policy_term_rule: Whole of life: policy term = 99 - entry age
premium_payment_rules: premium payments must end by age 75
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
key_features: Fully guaranteed; pay for 10 or 15 years or once.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Lifelong cover up to age 100 with bonuses (non-guaranteed). Pay for 10, 15 or 20 years only.
policy_term_rule: Whole of life: policy term = 100 - entry age
premium_payment_rules: premium payments must end by age 70
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to Rs 25 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: Sum assured + accrued simple reversionary bonuses + terminal bonus (if any).
maturity_benefit: At age 100: sum assured + accrued bonuses.
key_features: Cover for life (to age 100); limited premium payment; bonuses depend on the fund's performance and are not guaranteed.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Savings plan on a parent's life for a child's goal. If the parent dies, the family gets the sum assured at once, future premiums are waived, and the plan still pays at maturity.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 10 to 25
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
death_benefit: On the parent's death: 100% of sum assured paid immediately; all future premiums waived; policy continues.
maturity_benefit: Sum assured + accrued bonuses, paid at maturity (also when the parent has died earlier).
key_features: Choose the term so the plan matures when the child needs the money (e.g. at age 18); built-in premium waiver on the parent's death.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Guaranteed savings plan: the maturity amount is fixed on day one. Lower life cover than a term plan for the same premium.
premium_payment_rules: limited_5 needs policy term >= 10; limited_10 needs policy term >= 15
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to Rs 10 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: Higher of the sum assured and 10 x annualised premium.
key_features: Guaranteed maturity amount; short terms (10 to 20 years); pay for 5 or 10 years or for the full term.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 1 full year of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Endowment that pays part of the sum assured back at regular intervals during the term, and the rest plus bonuses at maturity.
policy_term_rule: One of 20, 25 years (20-year term: premiums paid for 15 years; 25-year term: for 20 years)
premium_payment_rules: policy term 20 uses limited_15; policy term 25 uses limited_20
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to Rs 10 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: Full sum assured (no deduction for money-back instalments already paid) + accrued bonuses.
maturity_benefit: 20-year term: 40% of SA + bonuses. 25-year term: 40% of SA + bonuses.
survival_benefits: 20-year term: 20% of SA at the end of years 5, 10 and 15. 25-year term: 15% of SA at the end of years 5, 10, 15 and 20.
key_features: Regular lump sums during the term; premiums are paid for 15 years (20-year term) or 20 years (25-year term).
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Savings plus life cover. Pays the sum assured plus bonuses at maturity, or on earlier death.
non_earning_applicant_rule: A person with no income may apply if their spouse works and has income: total individual cover (existing + new) up to Rs 10 lakh. min_annual_income_inr and income_multiple_limits do not apply to them.
death_benefit: Sum assured + accrued simple reversionary bonuses + terminal bonus (if any).
maturity_benefit: Sum assured + accrued simple reversionary bonuses + terminal bonus (if any).
key_features: Disciplined saving with life cover; bonuses are not guaranteed.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: at least 80% of premiums paid (or the surrender value, if higher) is paid instead of the death benefit, provided the policy is in force.
surrender_and_lock_in: Surrender value after 2 full years of premiums (simplified; not modelled in this pack).
medical_underwriting: Medical tests needed if sum assured > Rs 50 lakh or entry age > 45 (simplified).

plain_language_summary: Invest a lump sum once in market-linked funds with a small amount of life cover.
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
death_benefit: Highest of: sum assured, fund value, and 105% of the single premium.
key_features: One-time premium; 4 funds; partial withdrawals after the 5-year lock-in. Life cover is small (1.25x or 1.10x the premium).
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: the fund value on the date death is intimated is paid (plus any charges other than fund management charges deducted after death) instead of the death benefit.
surrender_and_lock_in: 5-year lock-in, as for Saffron Varnex Wealth.

plain_language_summary: Market-linked investment with life cover. Your premiums (after charges) buy units of the fund(s) you pick; the value goes up and down with the market.
policy_term_rule: Any whole number of years from 10 to 30
non_earning_applicant_rule: Not available to people with no income.
death_benefit: Highest of: sum assured, fund value, and 105% of total premiums paid.
key_features: Choose from 4 funds and switch between them; partial withdrawals allowed after the 5-year lock-in; investment risk is borne by the policyholder.
key_exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start/revival: the fund value on the date death is intimated is paid (plus any charges other than fund management charges deducted after death) instead of the death benefit.
surrender_and_lock_in: 5-year lock-in: if you stop paying or surrender in the first 5 years, the fund (less a discontinuance charge) moves to the discontinued policy fund and is paid out only after the lock-in ends.
